meta.name: Ensure Spanner Database is encrypted with Customer Supplied Encryption Keys (CSEK)
meta.description: Ensure Spanner Database is encrypted with Customer Supplied Encryption Keys (CSEK)

evaluators.description: google_spanner_database.encryption_config.*.kms_key_name must be a non-empty string. An absent or empty encryption_config block makes the wildcard path miss (severity 2, untolerated) and fails.
